description:
Unit: U2
Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-04-1314-refactor-jido-test-tree-plan.md#u2-consolidate-shared-support-and-helper-namespaces

Outcome
The repository has one compiled test-support root and one helper namespace without compatibility modules.

Requirements and decisions
R3, R4, R8, R10-R13, R15; KTD2, KTD3, KTD6, KTD8.

Affected surfaces
test/jido/support/**; test/support/**; mix.exs; .dialyzer_ignore.exs; test/test_helper.exs; and every active caller of moved or renamed support modules.

Implementation direction
Move test/jido/support into owner paths below test/support/jido and remove the second test compile path. Rename shared helpers and fixtures to Jido.Test.* and update callers atomically. Merge the duplicate OpenTelemetry tracers. Extract repeated public-API documentation helpers and AgentServer fixtures. Keep distinct case templates when setup differs. Remove old JidoActionTest.*, JidoSignalTest.*, JidoTest.*, and Jido.AITest.* support modules instead of forwarding them. Record every deletion.

Acceptance
The test environment compiles with lib and test/support as its only compile roots. Representative Action, Signal, AI, AgentServer, and persistence tests load final helpers. Dynamic modules keep unique names and diagnostics. Mimic, ExCoveralls, and Dialyzer references use final names.

Verification
mix compile --warnings-as-errors
mix test --seed 0 --warnings-as-errors
mix test.authoring --warnings-as-errors
mix test.property --warnings-as-errors
mix format --check-formatted

Completion signal
test/support is the only compiled support root, all active helper callers use final module names, and U3 can start.
title: U2 Consolidate shared test support
